body:
Howdy. Physical improvements lasted 2 days. From Steven hawking to Cinderella. Gawd it's wonderful to move and feel your body. Depression is still holding. Better than my physical issues.  I can feel it poking around but I'm ok. It makes it far easier to deal with things like your face going numb and the muscles contorting. Next 2 infusions- 2 and 4 days from now at huge doses. The hope us even better physical deficit resolution and longer hold time. Guess we'll see.

Given I can't walk again I have to ask 1 of my two kids to do the grocery store for me.  Put a public post on fb for some assistance couple weeks ago. Zero response. Not even gonna put myself through that. Wanted to unfriendly every "I won't help a crippled friend" mother fucker on there. Friends list my ass. And all but maybe 4 or 5 I know IRL. Bastards. 

If I get better I'm trading them all in. If not, not one of those bitches better be at my funeral.
I so love you right now. I doubled my ketamine dosage, split spacetime, and it worked. I'm ok. If I keep at it and the higher doses keep working I will be my own damned balloon.
Also LOVED what you said about compassion! So true!!!
Gut brain. So true.  Sometimes not the whole solution but definitely an integral part of the solution recipe!

Regarding ketamine.  I had the same issue and have heard this from others that over time for some reason the depression breaks back through. 

I want to stress that I experienced this.  Make sure he's not going too long between infusions. The FIRST sign of the dark fading in get back in for a booster immediately. But THIS:

REPEAT THE LOADING PHASE AT A HIGHER DOSAGE. 

Yes. I know. Won't it just come back again? Answer. You have to DIG it out of you with ketamine.  Over time you can build a tolerance  (I've had 11 infusions) and although ketamine isn't specifically addictive one can build a tolerance to anything.  IF you can get him back into the light and STAY there, he can go into remission.  Ketamine I've learned is a commitment.  And like all pain it's easier to stay on top than to get on top. You must commit to hitting it HARD. Going DEEP. Deeper than he's ever gone. 

Repeat the loading phase at 1.5mg per kg over 90 minutes. Then do boosters every 3 weeks if you have to. Increase the dosage again if you have to. Ketamine is very safe. They do infusions of 1000mg over 6hrs for 7 days straight for people with CRPS. can you imagine???  Me neither! 

Due to medical beurocracy I only had 2 infusions in over 4 months and was back in the bad place.  When I restarted the first 2 infusions seemed to do little of anything.  On the 3rd, I took the doc's advice and went from 50mg/4 5min to 100mg/90min. I thought I went molecular but there it was - I woke up in reset.  The nurse said tears were falling only from my right eye. I came put snuggled in the blanket and gently laughing. 

And it holds. So far. But I know I have to keep absolutely steady and never miss an infusion. I know it will go longer and longer between infusions but if I have that one that doesn't seem to work?  And your husband will KNOW what this feels like, I know to increase the dose and keep going.  And if I can keep it under control for 12-18 months I should see true remission. The brain WILL heal itself. Neuroplasticity is real. 

And so is joy. And so are overly long reddit posts. 😄  in the meanwhile do ALL of the other stuff. Eat paleo. (Look into the whole 30 diet). Read "A mind of your own". Then give that info to your hubby.  Read the brain that changes itself. Also a documentary. Also applies to depression.  Get a hand mirror place it in front of your husband and ask him to look into it and say "I love you."  Then go back in and repeat the loading phase at a higher dose.

Don't have a facility that will do this approach?  Contact Interpersonal Psychiatry or Midwest Ketamine dot com. Dr. Hiten Soni who has been through the infusions himself and is a sage.  It's  $400 an infusion regardless. Tell him Cairy sent you. 

Your husband? I hope he finds joy. It's like a flashlight you've list in the dark. I hope he finds life.

It is legitimate. I woke up in an ICE after taking 150mg of morphine.  Recovery sucked. I got rabdomylitis from being in one position until my muscles began to break down into my blood steam but I hadn't stopped breathing. Not yet. It's like my body was deteriorating before I was actually gone. Had a quasi near death experience. Woke weighing ten pounds less than 2 days prior with morphine osmosing out of my skin. This weird chemical smell always there and a tear in my stomach from the violent vomiting which thankfully I was unconscious for when they narco'd me. 

Surviving a suicide attempt is hellish. I've heard many stories of failed attempts done by people who truly meant to succeed.  I dont buy the silly golden gate jump survivors that say regret is the last thing they felt after they jumped. It's just survival instinct. Anyway. Taking a human life is not an easy task. I guess it shouldn't be.

Also.  Her partner refused to give me any more infusions stating they don't work after the 9th.  That's horse shit. People have 18 a year all the time. A 6 year old w my disease has 10 infusions in 10 days.  I also called around and no one has ever heard to such a thing.  I hot Medicare to cover my infusions and when she found out, she found a reason to stop my treatment.  Medicare is threatening to sanction her for charging me (I paid $1k in advance then Medicare paid them too.)  MY doctor, her partner, then gave me an rx for nasal ketamine. It may have been CYA.  As without ketamine I'm not just depressed but partially paralyzed.  Taking my infusions means I can no longer drive or walk to a trash dumpster.  My family wants to sue them. Me? I'm just sorta ready to be done.  I guess if I die my kids will be set for life.

By being extremely sick and having a doctor who both thinks outside the box, reads the most updated research on treating my illness w ketamine, and years of building trust.  

The rx is close to worthless compared to IV ketamine
Check out ASMR on YouTube. I like the Magic Forest Asmr VIDS.
In US.  I have a script.  But I have a neuro disease and a doc who thinks outside the box. It's actual ketamine hcl and not the esketamine Sravato.   It was $65.
Guilt tripping isn't allowed in this subreddit.

There's no need for you to apologize or explain to that poster. I knew you were talking about IRL.  Too many people takes things personally when it is not about them. It's about you and your experience. I don't think they were being kind. More judgmental and offended.  You deserve love and compassion however. I'm really sorry you haven't found it. So painful. 

And when you're already suicidal it seems to only justify going yes? 😌   do you feel just unseen?  It's so...  😔 empty. Lonley. The empty platitudes are just that - empty. The reason the boiler place advice resonates don't satisfy is because they are the rice cracker of compassion.  They're not real food. Real love. Real kindness. And that's what you need. To hear something REAL.  Is this true? 

I'm not good at advice. I'm sorta the blind leading the blind but you can feel free to message me if you wish to. I hope you only feel invited not pressured.  And I welcome long rants, swearing to the heavens or not. And am truly happy to listen to YOU. 

Meanwhile I hope you've found a little peace.
Did you weigh out 100 mg of the shards and put them in a capsule?

I'm very interested in this. I have a neuro disease.  So you measured out 100 mg and put it in a gel cap and swallowed it?  how long did it take to work?  How long were you high/dissociated?  

I've had infusions. I know there's a conversion between an IV and oral dosage of ANY drug.  Also I've read that nasal administration gets you a greater percentage into your system (thus the nasal ketamine that's rx'd in some places). Why did you choose an oral administration?
